# Reedy Creek Seventh-day Adventist Church

> A small, close-knit Seventh-day Adventist church at 7 Bridgman Drive, Reedy Creek QLD 4227, on the Gold Coast, Australia. Everyone is welcome.

Every Saturday: Prayer Meeting 9:10am, Sabbath School 9:30am, Church Service 10:45am, followed by a shared fellowship lunch.

## Pages

- [Home](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/): Service times, latest sermon, and an overview of church life
- [Plan Your Visit](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/visit.html): What to expect on your first visit, parking, children and families, FAQ
- [About Us](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/about.html): Our story and community
- [What We Believe](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/beliefs.html): Our beliefs in plain language
- [Sermons](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/sermons.html): Latest messages from our YouTube channel
- [Ministries](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries.html): Programs for families, youth and young adults, outreach, music, prayer and health
- [Sabbath School](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/sabbath-school.html): Saturday Bible study for adults, young adults and children
- [Contact](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/contact.html): Contact form and how to reach the pastor
